title: Restore HellCod MC Heading and Add Image Slideshow

requirements.summary: Restore the 'HellCod MC' heading to its prominent position at the top of the HeroSection component with existing typography styles
acceptanceCriteria: The 'HellCod MC' heading is displayed prominently at the top of the hero section
The heading uses white text with purple gradient effects matching the existing theme
The heading is visible in both light and dark modes with appropriate styling
The heading appears above the slideshow and server IP card

file_operations.description: Add the 'HellCod MC' heading at the top of the HeroSection component, above all other content. Apply white text with purple gradient effects using existing CSS classes and theme-aware styling. Ensure the heading is visible in both light and dark themes, positioned above the ImageSlideshow component (to be added) and all hero cards.

requirements.summary: Create ImageSlideshow component with automatic transitions, manual navigation, and responsive design
acceptanceCriteria: ImageSlideshow component renders all 6 Minecraft build images from frontend/public/assets/generated
Images automatically transition every 4-5 seconds with smooth fade effects
Manual navigation controls (previous/next arrows) allow users to browse images
Component is responsive and scales appropriately for mobile, tablet, and desktop
Slideshow styling matches the existing glassmorphism design aesthetic
Component works correctly in both light and dark theme modes

file_operations.description: Create a new ImageSlideshow component that displays 6 Minecraft server build screenshots from frontend/public/assets/generated (minecraft-build-1.dim_1920x1080.png through minecraft-build-6.dim_1920x1080.png). Implement automatic slideshow transitions every 4-5 seconds using setInterval. Add smooth fade transitions between images using CSS transitions or animations. Include manual navigation controls (previous/next arrow buttons) that allow users to browse images and reset the auto-transition timer. Ensure the component is fully responsive for mobile, tablet, and desktop viewports. Apply glassmorphism styling consistent with existing hero cards (backdrop blur, semi-transparent backgrounds, subtle borders). Support both light and dark theme modes using the existing ThemeContext. Use React hooks (useState, useEffect) to manage current image index and auto-transition logic.

requirements.summary: Position ImageSlideshow component in HeroSection after the heading and before existing cards
acceptanceCriteria: ImageSlideshow appears in the correct position: after the 'HellCod MC' heading and before the server IP card
The slideshow integrates seamlessly with existing hero section layout and spacing
The vertical hierarchy is: HellCod MC heading → slideshow → server IP card → three content cards
Component maintains proper spacing and alignment with surrounding elements

file_operations.description: Import and render the ImageSlideshow component in the HeroSection layout. Position it immediately after the restored 'HellCod MC' heading and before the existing server IP glassmorphism card. Ensure the vertical hierarchy is: HellCod MC heading → ImageSlideshow → server IP card → three content cards (Game Mode, Version, User Support). Apply appropriate vertical spacing (margin/padding) to maintain visual balance with surrounding elements. Do not modify the existing cards or their layout.

requirements.summary: Place 6 Minecraft server build screenshots as static assets and ensure correct image references
acceptanceCriteria: All 6 Minecraft build screenshots are saved as static assets in frontend/public/assets/generated
Images are named consistently (e.g., minecraft-build-1.png through minecraft-build-6.png)
ImageSlideshow component correctly references the image paths
